summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour delivers a detailed lecture on the conditions and pillars of prayer (salah), focusing on how the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) actually performed prayer rather than just listing theoretical requirements. He explains that there are nine conditions and fourteen pillars of salah, but emphasizes the importance of learning how the Prophet prayed by studying companion narrations. The majority of this lecture centers on the practice of praying with a sutra (barrier/wall in front), explaining that the Prophet always maintained approximately three cubits distance from a wall or object while standing, and about one cubit when in prostration. Sh. Ali Mashhour clarifies misconceptions about distance from the sutra and addresses weak hadith narrations, stressing that having a sutra during prayer was a consistent practice of the Prophet that is now often overlooked.
